items.title: E6 International Issuing Hub - Pending clean Agreement from legal so E6 can execute.
items.background: International Issuing Hub uses E6 as a third party vendor for the main end user portion of the application. For FIS to demo this new offering we require access to E6 demo assets in Coast.

items.deliverable: Agreement signature by Feb 20th, Demo Asset access by Feb 27th

items.title: Banking Audit - Demo Environment Assessment
items.background: Comprehensive banking audit scheduled with Richard Willcock to assess all demo environments, current status, and challenges across Banking Int. portfolio.
items.recommendation: Complete full audit of demo environments by end of February. Document current state, identify gaps, and establish priority remediation roadmap.

items.title: Technology License - Tiled access needed for CKO (Commercial Kickoff)
items.background: The Banking North America team requires additional Tiled licenses to support training and demonstrations of the tool at Commercial kick-off.
items.recommendation: Incorporate additional Tiled licenses into the demo technology spend whilst working towards temporary licenses with Tiled as interim solution.

items.title: MUFG $6M+ Demo AI Endpoint Build for Credit Assessment
items.background: Major Japanese client requested AI-powered credit assessment demonstration. Azure OpenAI endpoint deployment blocked by authentication policy conflicts requiring Network Security Architecture team engagement.
items.recommendation: Urgent engagement with Network Security Architecture Team on Azure AI authentication policies. Resolve subscription vs token-based authentication conflict.
items.deliverable: Azure authentication resolution and endpoint deployment by Feb 28, 2026

items.title: Demo Enablement - Licensing and Workspace Expansion
items.background: Capital Markets team requires additional licenses for demo technologies, Synthesia and Tiled and requires an official Coast workspace for generation of interactive Demo Assets
items.recommendation: Incorporate the license requirements into the wider demo technology spend whilst continuing to use their existing Synthesia and Tiled licenses alongside the complementary Coast demo services currently on offer.
items.deliverable: Demo Technology Spend decision by Feb 28th

items.title: Demo Enablement - Tiled access and Training
items.background: The payments team currently does not have access to Tiled as a plat and need to be brought up to speed with the technology on offer so they can start creating sales content microsites ready for CKO and wider sales engagements
items.recommendation: Provision Tiled licenses for Payments team. Schedule comprehensive training sessions covering platform features, best practices, and demo narratives.
items.deliverable: Licenses provisioned by Feb 13th; Training completed by Feb 20th

items.title: Coast MSA Renewal - Critical Finance Approval Required
items.background: Annual Master Service Agreement renewal for Coast platform ($267K) requires FIS Signature. Original approval deadline passed Jan 31. Risk of Demo disruption if signature delayed.
items.recommendation: Work with the procurement team in the US to have the requisition raised and approved
items.deliverable: P-REQ raised & approved by Feb 13th, Signature by Feb 18th

items.title: Executive Summary Platform - Final Testing Complete
items.background: A new Executive Summary Platform has entered final development testing ready for deployment as a central executive view into demo services. This supports increased transparency and visibility into all demo services activities.
items.recommendation: Deploy platform to production by end of week. Conduct executive briefing session to showcase capabilities.
items.deliverable: Platform deployed by Feb 13th, Network access by Feb 20th, Executive demonstrations from 1st March.

items.title: Governance Framework and Asset Flow Design
items.background: As new tools and technologies become available Governance and ownership and responsibilities are vital to ensure successful use, return on investment and adoption of said tools.
items.recommendation: Establish Demo Asset Governance review with pre-sales "Champions". Define asset lifecycle workflow from creation to retirement.

items.title: Technology Usage Visibility - License and Output Analysis
items.background: Lack of comprehensive reporting of technology usage across teams: which teams have licenses, user counts per tool, and output/ROI analysis. Required for budget planning and optimization.
items.recommendation: Conduct technology usage audit across all BUs. Collate license counts, active users, and demo output metrics. Identify underutilized licenses for reallocation.
